stemMd: The reform altered one procedure at a time over several years, making the transition ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Step-by-step change over time is gradual or incremental. The clue concerns pace and scale, not whether the reform could be reversed or avoided.

distractorRationale.a: The description gives no necessity claim.
distractorRationale.c: The pace does not establish reversibility.
distractorRationale.d: This also conflicts with change over years.
